intervals.moeSettle: Await completion/settlement and existing error/cancellation checks. Nested inside moe. Not GPUduration.
intervals.reuseChecks: Actual protected pair-reuse check in admission. Nested inside pairmoe. Also appears in raw IOcounters.
intervals.mixer: Input normalization through append/output selection. Pair batching counted once on first row; remaining row selections each measured. No route/head inside.
intervals.router: Projection, CPU routing/cutoff and existing route capture. Sourcepremap outside.
intervals.head: Final norm and head projection/readback. Final sourcecheck outside.
intervals.sampler: Whole existing FP32->FP16boundary plus sampler submission/wait/read. Includes sourceSampler.
intervals.turn: beginTurn incl full-sourcecheck and checkpoint clone.
intervals.restoreReplay: Existing restore plus accepted prefix replay. Child serial stage/source timings merged into totals. This interval overlaps those child stages. Replaycapture stores no route/logit values.
